description: Creates a link to the BitSpire contact form, prefilled with a subject and message. Nothing is sent: give the link to the user, who adds name and email and submits it. Do not put personal data such as email addresses or phone numbers into the message.

message.description: The inquiry in the user's words, at least 10 characters

subject.description: Short subject, for example 'AI agents for our .NET app'

name: start_inquiry
